title: Measures panel
responsibility: Displays recorded size and performance without estimating missing measurements.

inputs.name: MeasuresPanel.size
inputs.description: The size Measure that EntityView passes from entity.size for the Size row on the Overview tab. The row shows its text, or Not measured when the text is empty, and the value gets the measured class only when available is true; the panel never estimates a size or checks that available agrees with the text.

inputs.name: MeasuresPanel.performance
inputs.description: The performance Measure that EntityView passes from entity.performance for the Performance row on the Overview tab. The row shows its text, or Not measured when the text is empty, and the value gets the measured class only when available is true; the panel never estimates a performance figure or checks that available agrees with the text.

outputs.name: MeasuresPanel
outputs.description: The Size & performance panel that EntityView renders on the Overview tab: a heading and a detail list whose Size and Performance rows each show the measure's text, or Not measured when that text is empty. It calculates no measurements, infers no availability from the text, and has no throw or reject path of its own.
